assessment: The oncogenic virus Human Papillomavirus encodes the E7 protein which is an important contributor to carcinogenesis. The authors of this publication discovered a novel function of HPV E7, that contributes to its carcinogenic properties. They show that the ability of E7 to extend the lifespan of keratinocytes and facilitate basal cell retention are both activities mediated by the basal-cell specific activation of the cellular protein YAP1.
